snippet.title: Still Space | Official Teaser
snippet.description:
Still Space is a 2D action Metroidvania with resource management, circuit-based systems, and 360° combat. Explore a decaying research facility, restore power to key systems, and stay alive long enough to uncover what went wrong.

Visit our Steam page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3786760/Still_Space/
